note: v59.70 (data audit R10, owner 2026-11-04): the pass criteria are the seven gate blockers themselves, not tuned numbers. scripts/build-validation-gates.mjs judges each one from the research backtest artifact (public-data/factor-backtest-longrun.json, or the fresh one the research-backtest workflow writes) and writes public-data/screener-validation-gate.json and public-data/model-validation-status.json. A requirement is met only when the artifact carries the evidence named in `evidence`; a status changes only when every required one is met.

delistingAndCorporateAction.label: delisted names and corporate actions
delistingAndCorporateAction.evidence: universe.includesDelisted is true and methodology.corporateActions is 'adjusted'

filingAvailableDate.label: fundamentals as of filing availability
filingAvailableDate.evidence: methodology.fundamentalsAsOf is 'filing-available-date' and no factor is excluded for look-ahead

turnoverModeled.label: turnover
turnoverModeled.evidence: every overallByHorizon entry has a finite turnover

transactionCostsModeled.label: transaction costs
transactionCostsModeled.evidence: methodology.transactionCostBps is a finite number and methodology.returnsNetOfCost is true

liveBacktestParity.label: live/backtest parity
liveBacktestParity.evidence: methodology.excludedFactors is empty and methodology.regimeWeightsValidated is true
